issues.description: Farm.singFarmSong() has conflicting return types across artifacts. The problem statement/UML and the template define it as `singFarmSong(): void` that prints the song, but the solution implements `public String singFarmSong()` and returns the song text instead of printing. This mismatch breaks compatibility with any tests or student code written to the specified `void` signature and makes it unclear whether output should be printed or returned.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the contract. Prefer the specification/template: change the solution to `public void singFarmSong()` and print the verses (e.g., build a StringBuilder and `System.out.print(...)`). If returning a String is intended, update the UML/text and the template signature to `public String singFarmSong()` and adjust instructions/tests accordingly.

issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse(...) has inconsistent parameters across artifacts. The problem statement/UML specifies `singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void`, and the solution implements `private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`, but the template stub currently has no parameter (`private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)`), leaving students without the required `Animal` argument in the starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template stub to accept the parameter: `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (and add the Animal import/class as needed). If the intended design is to return a verse String, then update the UML/text to reflect `String` return and change the template accordingly.

issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse(...) has conflicting return types across artifacts. The UML specifies a `void` helper that prints (`singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void`) and the template stub is `void`, but the solution implements it as `private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` returning the verse text. This inconsistency makes it unclear whether students should print inside the helper or return a String to be printed/combined elsewhere.
issues.suggestedFix: Align helper behavior across all artifacts. Either (A) keep it `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` and print all lines inside, updating the solution; or (B) change the UML/text and template to specify `private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` and clarify that `singFarmSong()` concatenates/prints the returned verses.
